study: UK House of Commons 2024 election official constituency-level results
unit: UK constituency; up to 650, 4 nations and English regions
prespecified_exclusions: Only missing electorate/turnout or no winner-runner candidate votes for computation; report exclusions and special Speaker/NI observations; don't discard by result
classification: All cycles exploratory until independently replicated; contemporaneous margins and vote shares are post-election, cannot be used in genuine pre-election prediction.
A: Does the raw competition–turnout association persist within UK nations/regions, or is it predominantly a geographic/compositional contrast?

B.H1: Absolute coefficient attenuates materially (>= 30%) after region effects

C: Pre-register OLS without controls, OLS region/nation fixed effects, leave-one-UK-nation-out and regional Spearman; compare units pp/10pp margin and robust SE/CI, don't interpret 650 electoral seats as 650 independent randomized units.
F: Geographical fixed effects cannot capture class/age/education or incumbency and NI party systems differ
G: Single election; UK nations external strata internal to dataset.
J: If effect changes sign present it prominently.
